name: CyberDog
def: Xiaomi's first quadruped, released as a limited run of one thousand units for developers at 9,999 yuan.
body: CyberDog uses twelve in house servo motors rated at about thirty two newton metres, an Nvidia Jetson Xavier NX computer and eleven sensors including a depth camera and ultra wide angle fisheye lenses. Xiaomi published a developer interface and shipped the robot to engineers and enthusiasts rather than general consumers, positioning it as an open platform. It trotted at over three metres per second, followed a person and performed backflips, and was replaced by the smaller CyberDog 2 in 2023.
facts: Sold as one thousand units at 9,999 yuan to developers in August 2021
Shipped with an open developer interface rather than as a finished consumer product
specs: In house electric servo motors rated about 32 newton metres
Eleven sensors including depth and fisheye cameras, ultrasonic and inertial sensing
Onboard Nvidia Jetson computing with person following and voice control
